title: Mail Volume Fell To 109 Billion While Stamps Rose
hook: Mail volume fell to 109 billion, yet stamps got costlier.
closing: A shrinking mailbox still costs more because the delivery network does not shrink as quickly.
question: What do you still mail?

segments.say: Total mail fell to 109 billion pieces. The delivery network now carries nearly half its peak volume.
First-Class Mail fell to 46 billion pieces. Personal letters and bills are disappearing faster than mail overall.
A stamp reached 68 cents. Sending less mail did not make each letter cheaper.
